Mew.name: Mew
Mew.bio: Mew is a Burrito co-founder and former design lead who interviewed artists for the collective’s journal, including Artie Handz, Danil Pan, Max Kulchinsky, and Cliff.

emotionull.name: emotionull
emotionull.bio: Null (emotionull) is Burrito’s co-founder and technical lead, an artist and developer, and the creator of the Phettaverse and Clayground. Their writing in the journal includes artist interviews and publishing guides.
